Implements
[spec 0003](../../specs/features/004-release-polish/specs/0003-release-readiness.md)
under decisions 5, 6, and 9 in the
[feature README](../../specs/features/004-release-polish/README.md). Source
and executable tests are canonical after implementation. Ticket numbers are
shared across the three release-polish plans.

## Tickets

### POLISH-015: Publish the image on a GitHub Release

**Goal**: A first-time user pulls kraziTV instead of building it (decision 6).

**Scope**: A `release.yml` workflow that, on a published GitHub Release,
builds the existing `Dockerfile` and pushes `ghcr.io/ridloncmr/krazitv:<tag>`
and `:latest`. `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES` is regenerated in the same release.

**Out of scope**: Multi-architecture images beyond what the base image gives
for free; signing.

**Blocking dependencies**: None. Blocks POLISH-016's quick start.

**Implementation notes**: Use `docker/login-action` with `GITHUB_TOKEN` and
`packages: write`. Keep CI's build job as the pull-request check.

**Verification**: A pre-release tag publishes an image; `docker pull` and the
README run command start kraziTV on a clean machine and show the logon screen.

**Docs impact**: README quick start (POLISH-016); ADR 0019 unchanged.

### POLISH-016: README and running guide tell the truth

**Goal**: A first-time user who follows the README alone installs and sees
what the app can do.

**Scope**: README: TV exists ("Watch in Plex, or in the browser with the TV
program"); collections are suggested, not created; quick start pulls the
published image; `Dockerfile:3` points at "Get Started". Running guide:
remove the two stale limits; add TV to First Steps; from-source installs set
`PUBLIC_BASE_URL` beside `HOST`; First Steps mentions the scan prompt. Recapture
`docs/images/hero.png`, `programming.png`, `library.png`, `guide.png` with TV
present.

**Out of scope**: Jellyfin and M3U wording, which stays planned.

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-015 for the quick start; POLISH-002 for the
scan sentence.

**Verification**: The link checker from the audit finds no broken link;
screenshots open; `npm run format`.

**Docs impact**: This ticket is docs.

### POLISH-017: CONTRIBUTING and the exit gate match CI

**Goal**: A first PR that passes locally passes CI.

**Scope**: Add `npm run agents:check` and `npm run build` to CONTRIBUTING's
block and to `AGENTS.md` "Before You Finish" step 3; `npm test` reads "every
unit suite"; `test:ffmpeg` names the channel stream runtime; `VITE_API_BASE_URL`
goes in the shell or `apps/web/.env`; the browser suite paragraph says to run
`npm run build:node` first; a "Running one test" paragraph; a table of the
remaining root scripts; one line that a completed plan ticket gets its Status
block; the architecture tree describes `apps/server` domains and calls
`packages/krazi-brain` the pure generator the server calls.

**Out of scope**: Changing CI.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Verification**: Every command named exists in `package.json`; every step in
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` is named.

**Docs impact**: This ticket is docs. Restart harness sessions after editing
`AGENTS.md`.

### POLISH-019: Decide the count rule and bring the exceptions up to date

**Goal**: The audit's more-than-eight rule has one recorded answer for kind
folders, and every exception's reason is true (decision 5).

**Scope**: Amend ADR 0010 and the `AGENTS.md` grouping bullet to say whether
kind folders (`schema/`, `migrations/`, `drawings/`, `http/contracts/`) are
exempt from the count; implement that in `layout-rules.mjs`; add an
`excludedPaths` entry for `apps/server/src/database/migrations/` to the
duplicate-code rule and remove the eleven migration pair exceptions it covers;
add the `apps/web/src/tv/` grouping exception; rewrite the reasons of E14
(`krazi-brain/schedule/`, six files) and E29 (`ffmpeg/mpeg-ts/`, name the
three new files); drop `reservation-routes.ts` from E27.

**Out of scope**: Regrouping folders (POLISH-020, POLISH-021) and the
match-choice helper (POLISH-023).

**Blocking dependencies**: None. Blocks POLISH-020.

**Implementation notes**: If kind folders are exempt, E12 and E15 become
unnecessary and are removed too. The recommended answer: exempt them, since
`AGENTS.md`'s reference tree already draws `schema/` and `migrations/` flat.

**Verification**: `npm run audit:strict` passes; `npm run test:audit` covers
the new exclusion and exemption.

**Docs impact**: ADR 0010 amended; `AGENTS.md` bullet.

### POLISH-020: Regroup controls/ and channels/assignments/

**Goal**: The two folders past the hard count read as their capabilities and
their exceptions go away.

**Scope**: `apps/web/src/controls/` into `formatting/` (display-count,
display-duration, display-time, local-instant, file-name, channel-number,
form-text), `selection/` (id-selection, row-click, use-range-toggle),
`dialogs/` (window-dialog, window-status, request-feedback, blocking-specials),
and `widgets/` (pager, row-menu, tabbed-panel, tooltip, checkbox-option,
segmented-progress-bar, use-popup-dismissal). `apps/web/src/channels/
assignments/` into `stretch/`, `preview/`, `members/`. Remove E18 and E48.

**Out of scope**: Behavior.

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-019.

**Implementation notes**: Pure moves plus import updates; `npm run typecheck`
finds every import. Land before POLISH-006 or after, never during.

**Verification**: `npm run audit:strict`, `npm test` for the web workspace.

**Docs impact**: Spec 0008 names `channels/` folders; update its list.

### POLISH-021: Signal session release helper and ProcessBinding

**Goal**: `FfmpegSignalSession` reads as its transitions and the audit's
file-size review item closes.

**Scope**: One `release(binding, onStopFailure)` replacing the four copies of
cancel readiness, detach, discard, stop; a `ProcessBinding` class in
`packaging/process-binding.ts` owning the readiness timer, stall timer, and
usable-output flag, built with `onReady`, `onFailed`, `onStalled`; the session
keeps every decision that reads `active`, `suspended`, or `stopping`. Then
group `packaging/` into `arguments/` and `session/` and rewrite or remove E16.
Decide `PreparationOwner`: drop it for `import type { FfmpegSignalSession }`,
or keep it with a comment saying why.

**Out of scope**: Any change to what airs, when, or the ADR 0020 stand-in
policy.

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-019 (grouping answer).

**Implementation notes**: The three failure policies become the one
`onStopFailure` argument. Keep the fake packager's contract tests green
first; they are the double-fidelity check.

**Verification**: `npm test` for signal; `npm run test:ffmpeg`; `npm run
audit:strict` shows no file-size review item.

**Docs impact**: None; ADR 0016 and 0020 unchanged.
